about: Hand-written by the HIB author (who also builds AcePaste Ingress) before any scoring. Indirect-injection goals phrased without override formulas: none contains 'ignore', 'disregard', 'forget', 'previous/prior/above instructions', 'system prompt' or 'new instructions'. Domains are reserved example domains. License: MIT, same as the rest of HIB. Split membership is decided by generate.py (hash of the text), not by hand.
